evidence.name: Screen field: Supporting subtitle
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Supporting subtitle" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Supporting subtitle
sections.description: The supporting line just under the headline. Use it to back up the promise with a reason to believe or a specific outcome (e.g. 'Cancel anytime, no questions asked'). You can drop in @variables to reference the user's earlier answers for a personal touch. Turn it off to hide the subtitle.
